summary: Malformed client tool-search arguments record a function-call output with an empty call ID instead of the matching search output.
scenario: The model emits tool_search_call search-invalid with execution client and arguments {"query":7}; parsing fails, the original call is stored, and the response stored beside it is function_call_output with call_id "". The next prompt synthesizes an empty tool_search_output and treats the wrong output as orphan; a debug build panics at that orphan check and a release build drops the parse error.

evidence.point: Invalid SearchToolCallParams return RespondToModel before a ToolCall is created.
RespondToModel branch always stores FunctionCallOutput with an empty call ID.
Search calls pair with ToolSearchOutput by ID; the wrong function output is orphaned.
Ordinary tool-search failures use a ToolSearchOutput carrying the original call ID.

trace: ResponseEvent::OutputItemDone -> ToolRouter::build_tool_call (parse error) -> handle_output_item_done RespondToModel -> record_conversation_items (wrong output) -> ContextManager::for_prompt normalization -> synthetic search output plus orphaned function output -> next request or debug panic.

authority.quote: all function/tool calls must have a corresponding output

proof.name: malformed_tool_search_call_records_matching_search_output
proof.output: 1 test run: 0 passed, 1 failed; expected tool_search_output/search-invalid, observed function_call_output/empty call ID (malformed-tool-search-red.txt).
proof.command: RUSTC_WRAPPER= HOST_CC=clang HOST_CXX=clang++ CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=32 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/codex-harness-audit/ordering/codex-rs/target just test -p codex-core -E 'test(malformed_tool_search_call_records_matching_search_output)'

severity: Moderate: malformed model arguments are accepted by the response parser but the feedback loses its error and becomes an empty search result; debug builds panic while normalizing the orphan. Affects client tool-search discovery, with no evidence of a release-provider 400.
